# Face reference fixture

`astronaut.png`: NASA photograph of Eileen Collins, distributed by scikit-image v0.24.0. Its official `astronaut()` documentation declares: “No known copyright restrictions, released into the public domain.” The fixed source URL, license evidence and SHA256 are recorded in astronaut-provenance.json. Used for local face-landmark/registration software tests. No NASA or subject endorsement is implied. This one photograph is not a representative portrait/identity-preservation dataset.
